newsitem.title: USA: Saks stock plunges on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Saks stock plunges on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of Saks Holdings Inc. plummeted Wednesday after the upscale retailer warned of lower-than-expected earnings for the latest quarter.
Saks dropped $9 to $20.25 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said late Tuesday that its earning in its fiscal first quarter ending May 3 would be 20 cents a share, citing continued softness in its Folio catalogue operation.
Also on Tuesday, Saks offered to buy Barney's Inc. in a cash and stock bid valued at $290 million that would take the luxury clothing store group out of bankruptcy.

The Saks plan has the approval of Tokyo conglomerate Isetan Co., which holds leases on three of Barney's flagship stores. Saks said it and Isetan will submit their joint plan to a New York bankruptcy court for approval.
